name: Sunflower
intro: Tall stems carry yellow heads with dark centres. Height and flower size vary among cultivars.
observe: Broad oval to heart-shaped leaves feel rough and hairy. Watch the top bud open into a flower head.
habitat: Needs full sun and moist, well-drained soil. Tall plants may need support.
fact: Flowers attract bees; the seeds that follow provide food for finches.
